title: Biblical Symbol Functions — Throne, Footstool, Ark, River, Serpent, Stone, Shepherd, Lion, Lamb and Red Heifer
purpose: Prevent recurring biblical symbols from collapsing into one mythic blob by recording their distinct textual functions, transformations and project-neighbor relations.
epistemic_rule: A symbol may do different things in different biblical texts. Project synthesis comes after text-specific function and should not turn comparison into fulfillment or identity.

symbols.distinction: Throne is office/sovereignty, not identical with House, Mountain or Heaven.
lower position is not automatically worthless or enemy-status.

functions: Noahic vessel in a different narrative family
symbols.distinction: Ark of Covenant and Noah's ark are different objects; 'Mashy Ark' is project synthesis.
river can nourish and delimit; not one universal CSF code.
Biblical serpent functions are not interchangeable with kuṇḍalinī or generic evil.
Shepherd is not Door or Lamb though one figure may bear both roles.
Lion of Judah must not absorb every biblical lion.
Lamb is not simply the opposite of Lion; Revelation deliberately joins paradoxical roles.

functions: Numbers 19 purification from corpse-impurity through burning, ashes and water of lustration
symbols.distinction: The rite is not a generic messianic cow symbol.

functions: container/carrier metaphor across many texts rather than one single biblical symbol-system
symbols.distinction: Specify which text/object rather than using vessel as a universal biblical title.

key_stacks: Throne → River of Life → Tree of Life → Fruit/healing in Revelation 22 context
Stone → House/Gate in Jacob; Stone → Mountain in Daniel; Cornerstone → living-stone House in 1 Peter
Death/corpse impurity → Red Heifer burning → Ash + living/fresh water → purification in Numbers 19
Shepherd guides; Door mediates; Lamb sacrifices; Lion rules/victory-symbolizes: these roles can converge christologically without becoming synonyms
conversation_genealogy: 2026-05-28: Lion/Lamb/Goat/cow/serpent/stone/ark/root/manna/door symbols were woven into one project map.
2026-08-31: Throne→River→Tree→Fruit/healing recovered as a distinct Revelation stack.
